<div class="card-body">
'''Dantooine''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[System]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ダントウイン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">大型艦の配備コストに－２、宇宙戦闘機の配備コストに－１される。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-122o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配していれば、フォース消耗が＋１される。</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Lore</h2>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Dantooine.

'''Card text:''' Capital starships deploy -2 and starfighters deploy -1.

'''Lore:'''

'''Dark Side card text:''' If you control here, Force drain +1.
